Deterministic replays are back in fashion for puzzle games

Recording inputs instead of state turns a bug report into something you can run. Three teams describe what it cost them and what they stopped doing afterwards.

The idea is old, the reason it returned is new: with input logs small enough to attach to every crash, the question changes from "can you reproduce it" to "which frame".

Two of the three teams now refuse a bug report without one.

The cost is a few minutes per merge.
